rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: HE/rapid trigger is now treated as baseline for 2026 gaming keyboard launches per buying-guide roundups; growth is plateauing near saturation.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: MX2A's early scratch complaints are largely resolved, but Cherry's classic MX line keeps ceding mindshare to Gateron and HE magnetic switches.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Emerald
rows.note: The 150M-cycle magnetic tactile with adjustable actuation keeps gaining vendor stocking momentum since its Gamescom debut.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: No fresh catalyst this week; T1 holds steady as a budget-tactile staple with no new vendor or group-buy activity.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: The silent/tactile trio sees steady restocks, remaining a top silent-switch pick amid 2026's quieter-setups demand wave.

rows.name: GMK CYL Orange Alert
rows.note: The group buy enters its final week before an estimated Sep 14 close, driving last-call urgency at Divinikey, KBDfans, and Geonworks.

rows.name: GMK CYL TA Neo
rows.note: Now firmly in quiet post-buy production tracking ahead of a Nov-Dec ship, with attention shifted to newer GMK CYL runs.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: With sibling set Molch's buy wrapped toward a Q1 2027 ship, the Dolch family has settled into a quiet post-buy holding pattern.

rows.name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
rows.note: Niche interest holds steady as an add-on kit for Hineybeige/Dolch R5 builds, with no new developments this week.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Split/ergo demand keeps climbing, with market trackers citing steady growth through 2033 and Keychron's Q11/Q13 Max named category leaders.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Recovery continues into a second week; 2026 buying guides now call Alice plus full-split the era's biggest layout trend, led by Keychron's Q13 Max.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: Holds its lead at roughly 42% share of the custom-keyboard community's preference; still the default recommendation with no new catalyst.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: Mode teased Prologue, a new 98% board with pre-orders opening Sep 17, on top of its Encore/Sonnet refresh and new crown mounting system.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Blaine V2: SE closed its group buy and moved into production; no new group buy launched from the vendor this week.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: The Finn 60XT kit keeps tracking toward its ship window with the Paper 65 kit still in the coming-soon queue; steady vendor cadence, no surprises.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Multi-front momentum continues with a ceramic-TMR Q16 HE 8K Kickstarter and the V6 Ultra Hybrid pre-launch both live, reinforcing category-dominant cadence.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: Cherry keeps losing coverage share to magnetic and TMR rivals, with Keychron's ceramic-TMR Q16 HE and Gateron's magnetic lineup dominating this week's headlines instead.

rows.name: Topre / HHKB
rows.note: HHKB's Back to School promo through Sep 30 keeps Topre boards in budget shopping guides, nudging brand sentiment up a notch.
